public_rationale: On the ordinary project-level reading, Stargate existed beyond publicity: OpenAI reported construction and partial operation at Abilene before the post. There is substantial qualification. Contemporaneous reporting said the original SoftBank joint venture had not closed a data-center deal and that OpenAI was applying the Stargate name to separate projects. The outcome therefore depends on the referent. It does not establish that Stargate would save OpenAI financially.
limitations: The narrower joint-venture reading has material supporting context.
Operational status comes from a project participant's disclosure.
The proposed outcome addresses substantive existence, not completion of all announced investments or OpenAI's survival.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Stargate doesn't exist beyond media hype and won't save OpenAI.

statement.excerpt: Stargate isn’t saving it, either. As I wrote previously, Stargate doesn’t actually exist beyond the media hype it generated.

from_speaker: Stargate doesn’t actually exist beyond the media hype it generated
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading of the firm existence claim is that Stargate has no substantive infrastructure activity beyond publicity.
Construction, operational capacity or binding infrastructure agreements count as substantive existence; full delivery of every announced ambition is not required.
This is an ongoing operational-state claim. The reporting window is the latest completed calendar month before publication, July 2025, through the August 6 publication date.
'Isn’t saving it' supplies no measurable financial-rescue threshold or deadline and is not independently resolved by evidence that infrastructure exists.

The name can refer either to the original SoftBank joint venture or to OpenAI's broader infrastructure program. The proposed outcome uses the latter ordinary project-level reading and records contrary evidence about the narrower venture.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous evidence establishes that the project remained publicity and plans, with no substantive construction, operation or binding infrastructure activity.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous evidence establishes physical infrastructure construction or operation, or executed infrastructure agreements, identified with Stargate.
